 TOI Entertainment Desk / etimes.in / Updated: Nov 19, 2026, 09:24 IST Save Comments Share Aa + Text Size Small
 Medium
 Large
 Print GTA. Actor Pooja Hegde has joined the excitement surrounding the launch of 'Grand Theft Auto VI'. The actress recently gave fans a glimpse of her preparations through an Instagram Story. She shared a picture of her pre-load download queue and wrote, “All geared up,” signalling her readiness to play the highly anticipated title. 'Grand Theft Auto VI' is scheduled to launch on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X/S on November 19. The release has generated considerable interest among gaming enthusiasts, including celebrities and content creators in India. Pooja Hegde is among those who have openly spoken about their passion for video games. The actress has previously discussed several titles she enjoys playing. During an interview with Chalachita Clips, she spoke about her experiences with popular games across different genres. Her list includes action-adventure titles, open-world games, racing experiences and multiplayer releases. Pooja Hegde talks about completing ' Ghost of Tsushima '
 One of the titles Pooja Hegde discussed was 'Ghost of Tsushima'. The actress revealed that she had progressed considerably through the game and completed its optional missions. Her comments suggested that she enjoys exploring the different elements of a game rather than simply following its main storyline. Speaking about her progress, she said, "I am on the third island now, but I did everything. Again, if you see my map and you have seen, I have done all side missions, everything." She also mentioned 'Uncharted' and 'The Last of Us' during the conversation. Both games are recognized for their cinematic storytelling and character-driven narratives. ' Red Dead Redemption ' impressed the actress with its story
 Pooja Hegde also shared her thoughts on Rockstar Games' 'Red Dead Redemption' and its sequel. She described the original game as challenging but praised its narrative and cinematic presentation. The actress also highlighted the different choices available to players in 'Red Dead Redemption 2'. She said, "Then I played 'Uncharted', I played Last of Us which is also a really good one. And Xbox, I played Red Dead Redemption 1. That game is also the toughest one, but the story is very nice and it's quite cinematic also. As a person who loves films, you will really enjoy that. And then you can play it again. Like, there's a honor meter in Red Dead Redemption 2 so you can play it as a bad guy and you can play it as a very good person. " Why Pooja Hegde believes video games deserve recognition
 The actress also spoke about the effort involved in developing video games. She pointed out that creating a game requires extensive research, investment and creative work. Pooja Hegde compared the cost of buying a game with spending money on everyday purchases. She said, "I also feel like, these people taking so much time in creating a game, and there is lot of labor , research, money that goes into, and some games are worth that. ometimes we buy a jacket for three thousand or four thousand, we don't think about it, we'll wear it ten times. This is like, you will spend how many hours people have spent on that. Like to design graphics is not easy. It's a very labour intensive work to make sure that there are no glitches. It's a very labor -intensive work to make sure that there are no glitches. I feel like you're paying them for the time that they put in and as artists especially, it's very important to pay back." 'Zelda', 'Mario Kart' and other games on her list

 Pooja Hegde also discussed how players can share games with friends and make their purchases worthwhile. She particularly praised titles such as 'The Legend of Zelda' and 'Red Dead Redemption' for the value they offer. She said, "It's different when you can't then you borrow it from a friend. You know like today I bought a puzzle, I'll give it to you. You'll also enjoy it. Paisa vasool ho gaya. I feel a lot of the games like Zelda is fully paisa vasool. Red Dead Redemption also. Sometimes I watch the entire credits when I finish the game." Her other gaming favorites include 'Mario Kart', 'Overcooked 2' and 'Forza Horizon 5'. These choices reflect her interest in different styles of gaming, beyond action and adventure. On the professional front, Pooja Hegde's recent film appearances include 'Retro' and 'Deva', both released in 2025. She also made a special appearance in 'Coolie'. She also played the female lead in Vijay starrer 'Jana Nayagan'.
